cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll finish dinner, then I'll walk you home. You keep saying you're managing. What's hard about going back?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The silence. I leave the television on so it sounds occupied.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask me in when we get there. I'll leave whenever you want.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can stay for tea. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make the tea. Ask me to stay without that promise.

reason: Replace status slogans with an evening plan, an adjustable visiting limit and taking over tea; preserve B guarded hospitality without inexplicably cooking a second dinner.
